questions.q: Why write a root-cause document for a bug that's already fixed?
options: Power BI requires documentation before a report can be republished
It has no real value once the fix is confirmed working
It turns a one-time fix into institutional knowledge, instead of relying on someone's personal memory later
It's only useful if the bug reappears the same week
questions.explain: Without a written record, whether 'this happened before' is answerable depends entirely on personal memory, which fades.

questions.q: What are the four sections a useful root-cause document includes?
options: Summary, Budget, Timeline, Signatures
Title, Author, Date, Version number only
Introduction, Background, Conclusion, References
Problem, Root cause, Fix, Prevention
questions.explain: These four sections give the next reader exactly what was wrong, why, what changed, and how to avoid it recurring.

questions.q: How should the 'Problem' section be written?
options: Identical to the Root Cause section
As a guess about what might be wrong
The way it was originally reported, not the way you later understood it
Using only internal DAX terminology the reporter wouldn't recognize
questions.explain: Keeping the Problem section grounded in the original report preserves an accurate record of what was actually observed.

questions.q: Why is 'double-check your measures before publishing' considered a weak prevention step?
options: It is technically impossible to double-check a measure
It would require deleting the model
It gives no concrete action to actually do differently or for a reviewer to check
It applies only to the Drill-Down page
questions.explain: A specific, checkable rule — like using a display folder and explicit naming for ALL()-based measures — is actionable in a way vague advice isn't.

questions.q: What is the actual, specific prevention step recorded in this lesson's document?
options: Rebuild the data model from scratch every month
Disable the Region slicer on the Executive Summary page
Any new ALL()-based measure goes into the Benchmarks display folder immediately, with a name that makes the override explicit
Never use CALCULATE in any measure again
questions.explain: This is the specific, checkable rule this lesson's root-cause document records as its prevention step.
